backgrounds: Bright painted scenes with local receiver masks. Cat: passing cloud illumination and moving window slat shadows, restrained lamp glow, dust and wet neon reflections. Parrot: sea-only UV waves with travelling crests, fixed horizon/architecture, rare gull and feature light string. Focus holds motion; reduced motion remains static. V5 strengthens clipped passing cloud/window illumination, sea UV displacement and depth-dependent moving wave crests; fixed architecture is preserved.

animation.articulation: native jacket shoulder facings over sleeve roots, registered cuffs, collar-pinned lower ruff and neckline pivot
animation.respiration: Independent track 1: nonrigid weighted abdomen, ribs, neck and cheeks; two unequal breaths with pauses over 11.6s cat / 10.2s macaw. Feet remain planted.
animation.limbRepair: Cat V6: native jacket shoulder facings cover the moving sleeve roots; both shoulders and cuffs use contact-patch checks. V5 sleeve opening centre registered to rear wrist, palm inserted into cuff, head lowered 32 source pixels onto collar, head pivot moved to neckline and lower ruff pinned to neck. Includes both cuffs, active stamp and collar contact checks. Parrot retains V4 registered feather roots, fold/raise/unfold corridors and layered props.
animation.review: cast/motion-review/motion.gif: shipped character player with continuous breath, crossfades and return to idle. Both V6 captures at 20fps, with actual player crossfades, held loops and returns. Full move list in all-actions.png.
animation.prizes: Object-specific part and mesh performances: fish/water, lid/tail, yarn/thread, leaves, record/label, cord, telescope eye, straw/umbrella and scatter accents. Winning clip 640ms / scatter 820ms, with reduced-motion path and single completion.

audio.creation: Original procedural music and nonverbal synthesized character voices, not live recordings.
